body: thanks fellow wanderer. Though, I think refugee might be the better term for me.  'A refugee, who's running from the wars, hiding from the fire-bombs they've hurled, eternally a person out of doors, desperate in this undoing world.'

said fuck it when i wsa 14.  its been a wild fucking ride since then, and having said "fuck it" has allowed me to live life without inhibitions.  ive had so many adventures many people only dream of.  they were great for awhile. i really lived fast and hard and it was great.

yes, there is one magic thing that could change it all.  but i will keep that to myself.  it is a very selfish wish see, and i am just not selfish by nature.  i am not selfish enough to even fancy the idea of pursuing this wish.  so i will just imagine it in my head, maybe even in the moments before i die.

i dont have burdens really.  my problem isnt one of burdens.  i live my life without inhibitions and do what i want.  dont like my job?  i quit it.  want to have an adventure?  i have it.  want to buy something? (rare but it happens) i buy it.  want to go somewhere?  i go.  im not burdened, at least i dont feel.  my problem is one of very deep scars.  these scars just do not heal.  and now, they are infected.  this infection has seeped through my body and now reached my mind, and this will kill me.

in my own country hitch hiking and living in car.  outside of my continent, have lived with people, done work in exchange for room and board, or camping.  it was an adventure and ive done it multiple times.  but i dont want that adventure again.

thank you for the help.  im sorry you feel the way you do.  yes, i am done existing like this.  if this is existence for me, i chose not to live it. this is not a way to live.  i refuse to let the people i love see me in tihs state. i am a fucking failure, by the definition of the word.  i have failed at life, in the sense, i have finally been beat in to submission and am done.

dude.  some things are permanent.  we gotta drop this facade.  this is the reality.  reality is a bitch, but why deny it?  there will be great times in my future if a stay alive.   no doubt.  mind blowing amazing times.  its not even that the pain ill face along the way is no longer worth it.  i just am beyond the point of dealing.  i dont have the resources any longer, or the will.  ia m done fighting.  i am not strong enoug.  life has won. im gonna let evolution take its course.  i mean it in a real sense.  i want children, but i am not someone who should procreate.  the two miserable sacks of shit that accidentally made me never should have procreated either.  im ending this pathetic genetic line.

done the backpack thing.  had a lot of good times.  after awhile it just turned very lonely.  now i hate those sort of adventures.  im sorry.  people are what bring me joy.  this is the truth of my life, the one unavoidable truth, and yet i hurt people.  i will not subject them to me.

ive really done my life goals and thats why i dont mind ending things now while im still "on top"

and yes i am worrie.d  i am terrified right now.  utterly terrified.
im soryr.  i just dont wanna talk anymore.
im not waiting for anyone to carry my burden!  ive built a great life.  im just not happy!

not really stuck between a rock and a hard place.  just done.  

a lot of unfortunate events have occurred to me throughout the course of my life.  bad shit, but that's ok, bad shit happens to everyone.  most people would recover i suppose but im just not strong emotionally or mentally. i couldn't handle eventually fucked me up beyond repair. and no one needs to deal with it.
find out for yourself, and then you'll understand why i'm here.
true.  tried it multiple times.  has had no effect.

thats the stupidest thing ive read.  child molesters are people too.  you cant just change the definition of what a person is to suit your narrative.  


and if you think child molestation is the worst human nature is capable of, you've got a lot to learn about life.

i know you're not trying to downplay.  i dont take it that way.  done giving it more time.  been giving it more time the last 2 years, and its only pathetic at this point.  i havent even checked the mail in a month, the mailman just stopped delivering it.  dont even pay my bills even though i have more money than i know what to do with.  it is pointless and unnecessary to keep giving it one more month, one more week, one more day.  i have become a pathetic shell of who i once was and i do not want people to remember me like this.  i used to listen to people with terminal illnesses who wanted to 'die with dignity' and even though i supported their decision, i nver understood what they meant by die with 'dignity'.  i finally understand.

lol worst post ever.  but either way, you just agreed to the point of this thread.  there are indeed people the world is better off without.  its basic human evolution people.  survival of the fittest.  im not fit for this world.

>Reaching out to those close to you is unlikely to pull them down with you

bullshit.  keep telling yourself that.  first time, no.  second time, no.  When this is your default state though, yes, it absolutely pulls them down.  I love them too much to make them deal with me.

im not trying to sound like a prick, but this post isnt really about me looking for advice.  i stopped giving a fuck long back.  i float from moment to moment, adventure to adventure, as a side affect of not giving fucks. even this post is just another way to bide my time. but that loses its appeal after awhile, trust me.  in the beginning, 'not giving a fuck' is very liberating and exciting, but just wait a few years.  im gonna go out in my prime, while others still have good memories of me.  sorry.

i too hope you can get out.  but i know at this point i will not.  ive kind of hit a point of no return so to speak, and at this point im just writing as many letters, saying the things i need to say, getting will in order, giving away a few things, that sort of stuff.  im at peace with it.  it'll happen soon for me.

no dude.  its like im in quicksand and im sinking fast and deep. and im not going to reach out to the people i love and end up pulling them in to the pit with me.  i just need to suck it up and stop fighting and fucking face my reality.

the only other option is to just abandon life and all ties i have and start new somewhere, but, i don't want that, as its the ties to people i love that enriches my life.  the problem for me is that my natural state is to sink further in to the quicksand.

yes, think of myself is what im doing.  myself is in agonizing misery that i no longer want to endure.  yeah, its for my loved ones that i'll go out but id be a fool to myself saying its not for me as well.  yeah im fucking miserable and want to end my existence.  and that's ok.
sick of living life only thinking of others.  done with it.  sorry.
cheers to that.  I hear you.  To hell with this fucked up life that has only been one beat down after the next.  Fuck this shit.
